import json

class Severity(str, Enum):
    INFO = "INFO"
    NOTICE = "NOTICE"
    WARNING = "WARNING"
    ALERT = "ALERT"
    CRITICAL = "CRITICAL"

SEVERITY_LOG_LEVELS = {
 Severity.INFO: logging.INFO,
 Severity.NOTICE: logging.INFO,
 Severity.WARNING: logging.WARNING,
 Severity.ALERT: logging.ERROR,
 Severity.CRITICAL: logging.CRITICAL,
}

def parse_severity(value: Any) -> Severity:
 if isinstance(value, Severity): return value
 if isinstance(value, str):
   try: return Severity(value.upper())
   except ValueError: pass
 raise ValueError(f"Invalid severity: {value!r}")

def utc_now() -> datetime: return datetime.now(timezone.utc)

def to_jsonable(value: Any) -> Any:
 if isinstance(value, datetime): return value.isoformat()
 if isinstance(value, Enum): return value.value
 if isinstance(value, Path): return str(value)
 if isinstance(value, (list, tuple, set)): return [to_jsonable(i) for i in value]
 if isinstance(value, dict): return {str(k): to_jsonable(v) for k,v in value.items()}
 return value

class SecurityLogger:
    def __init__(self, log_file: Optional[str]=None, logger_name: str="security", level: int=logging.INFO):

       self._logger.propagate=False
       if not self._logger.handlers:
          handler=logging.StreamHandler(sys.stderr)
          handler.setFormatter(logging.Formatter("%(asctime)s %(levelname)s %(message)s"))
          self._logger.addHandler(handler)
       self._json_path=Path(log_file).expanduser().resolve() if log_file else None
       if self._json_path: self._json_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    def log_event(self, event):

          self._logger.log(level, "SECURITY [%s] %s: %s", event.severity.value, event.category, event.message)

class SecurityMonitor:
    def __init__(self, thresholds: Optional[Mapping[Any, int]]=None, window_seconds: float=60.0, cooldown_seconds: Optional[float]=None, alert_callback: Optional[Callable[[Alert], None]]=None):
       self._lock=threading.Lock()
       self.window_seconds=float(window_seconds)
       self.cooldown_seconds=float(cooldown_seconds) if cooldown_seconds is not None else self.window_seconds
       self.alert_callback=alert_callback
       self._events_by_severity={sev: deque() for sev in Severity}
       self._last_alert_time={sev: None for sev in Severity}
       self._thresholds={}
       if thresholds:
          for key, value in thresholds.items():
             sev=parse_severity(key)
             if int(value) <=0: raise ValueError...
             self._thresholds[sev]=int(value)
    def record(self, event):
       alerts=[]
       with self._lock:
          now=event.timestamp
          for sev in self._events_by_severity: # maybe only event.severity
          self._events_by_severity[event.severity].append(now)
          self._prune(now)
          for sev, threshold in self._thresholds.items():
             count=len(self._events_by_severity[sev])
             last=self._last_alert_time[sev]
             if count >= threshold and (last is None or (now - last).total_seconds() >= self.cooldown_seconds):
                alert=Alert(severity=sev, message=f"{count} {sev.value} security events within {self.window_seconds:.0f}s", category="MONITOR", event_count=count, window_seconds=self.window_seconds, sample_events=[{"severity": sev.value, "timestamp": now.isoformat()}])
                self._last_alert_time[sev]=now
                alerts.append(alert)
                if self.alert_callback: self.alert_callback(alert)
       return alerts
    def _prune(self, now):
       cutoff=now - timedelta(seconds=self.window_seconds)
       for sev, dq in self._events_by_severity.items():
          while dq and dq[0] < cutoff: dq.popleft()
    def summary(self):
       with self._lock:
          cutoff=utc_now() - timedelta(seconds=self.window_seconds)
          counts={}
          for sev, dq in self._events_by_severity.items():
             while dq and dq[0] < cutoff: dq.popleft()
             counts[sev.value]=len(dq)
          return {"window_seconds": self.window_seconds, "counts_by_severity": counts}
